body.title: (Web Scraping) Help Automate a an analytic report
body.aiReason: Job requires web scraping, data extraction, and automated reporting—matches my scraping, ETL, and dashboard skills; client appears legitimate.
body.description:
Hi I am looking for an automatic report that I can access which shows when a products price ends in a 1 on a specific retailers site. (for example $10.81, $4.91, $25.91) .This indicates a SALE/CLEARANCE item and I would like to have access to a report/list of those items as they become available
And then a report that shows all the new items added to the site on a daily basis.
